chapters.label: Vienna, live
chapters.text: Vienna, 1990, the European Cup final. Milan against Benfica, nil-nil. Costacurta plays it forward to Marco van Basten, a soft pass, and Frank Rijkaard races through... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Two quick passes forward, and Benfica are not ready. Van Basten rolls it into the space, and Rijkaard runs onto it.

chapters.label: Into the corner
chapters.text: The outside of his right foot... past the keeper, into the corner! One-nil. Milan are champions of Europe again!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: win the ball, then pass it forward quickly, before the other team is ready.
